test_title: PYST 29: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A class of 78 students took a Physics test. 17 students had an average score of 70. The remaining students had an average score of 90. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assumed Average = 90

Deviation for 17 students = 17 × (70 − 90) = −340

Net change in average for 78 students = −340 ÷ 78 ≈ −4.36

Correct average = 90 − 4.36 = 85.64...

**∴ The correct answer is 85.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of students = 78

Number of students in first group (n₁) = 17, Average score (A₁) = 70

Number of students in second group (n₂) = 78 − 17 = 61, Average score (A₂) = 90

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/386243c140c1c2eaf99be034b3b5519cf918e61761ff431f17368a773d51c600.png] 

⇒ Total score of first group = 17 × 70 = 1190

⇒ Total score of second group = 61 × 90 = 5490

⇒ Combined total score = 1190 + 5490 = 6680

⇒ Class average = 6680 ÷ 78

⇒ Average = 85.6410...

Rounding to one decimal place, we get 85.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 85.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

It is used to find the average of groups with different sizes: Avg = (n₁w₁ + n₂w₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Assumed Mean Method

Calculation is simplified by taking a temporary average and adjusting by (Sum of deviations ÷ Total count).

Rounding Rule

To round to one decimal place, look at the second decimal digit; if it is 5 or more, round up the first decimal digit.
